# opnsense_syslog_destination (Data Source)

Remote syslog destinations forward OPNsense logs to an external log collector (System ‣ Settings ‣ Logging ‣ Remote).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the remote logging target.

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String) ID (refid) of the certificate used for TLS transports.
- `description` (String) Description of the remote logging target.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this remote logging target is enabled.
- `facility` (Set of String) Syslog facilities forwarded.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname or IP address of the remote log collector.
- `level` (String) Minimum log level forwarded.
- `port` (String) Port of the remote log collector.
- `program` (Set of String) Applications/programs forwarded.
- `rfc5424` (Boolean) Whether RFC 5424 message format is used.
- `transport` (String) Transport used to deliver log messages.
